# cpanel_ftp_account (Resource)

Manages a cPanel FTP account, password, home directory, and disk quota.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "ftp_account_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "cpanel_ftp_account" "website" {
  username              = "deploy@example.com"
  password              = var.ftp_account_password
  password_version      = 1
  home_directory        = "public_html"
  quota_mib             = 1024
  delete_on_destroy     = false
  delete_home_directory = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `home_directory` (String) The FTP account home directory relative to the cPanel account home.
- `quota_mib` (Number) The disk quota in MiB. Use `0` for unlimited when the cPanel account permits it.
- `username` (String) The complete FTP login in `user@domain` form.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `delete_home_directory` (Boolean) Whether deleting the FTP account also deletes its home directory and contents. Defaults to `false` and has no effect unless `delete_on_destroy` is `true`.
- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether deleting the Terraform resource also deletes the FTP account. Defaults to `false`. cPanel does not expose an immutable account identity, so enabling this option accepts that a same-name replacement with the same observable home directory and quota cannot be distinguished from the managed account.
- `password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The FTP account password. Configure it together with `password_version`. Terraform never stores it in plan or state artifacts.
- `password_version` (Number) A positive version that triggers an in-place password update when changed. It must be configured together with `password`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_ftp_account.website deploy@example.com
```
